_comment: PEMF -- the waterfront: things to do in port besides the game's own.
One row in the town menu, 'Walk the waterfront', just above 'Leave'. It
opens a menu of the events below. Nothing of the game's own is changed.
bribe   value = gold. This port's crown forgets the recent fright:
their suspicion meter empties and the forgivable part of what
being unmasked cost you is written off. What you actually did
stays on the books. Shows its own card.
gossip  what the waterfront knows about you: hunters out, ports shut,
who is asking questions. Shows its own card.
Delete this file to remove the row.

menus.title: The waterfront of {port} is loud with gulls, hawkers and the creak of moored ships.

events.body: The harbourmaster keeps his office above the customs shed, a ledger open on the desk and his hand never far from it. For 300 gold, he lets it be known, a ship's record can be made to read however its captain prefers.

options.outcome: You leave him to his books. He does not look up.

events.body: The dockside tavern is full of sailors between ships, and sailors between ships talk.

options.outcome: You drink alone and learn nothing, which has its own value.

events.body: A knot of dockhands is idling by the bollards, between ships and short of drink money. A round or two, the foreman suggests, and some of them might be persuaded to ship out.

options.outcome: Three of them follow you back to the ship before the night is out. Your crew is {crew} strong.
You walk on. They go back to idling.

events.body: The chandler has salt pork that has not turned, ship's biscuit without weevils, limes, and a barrel of decent rum. Fresh stores, he says, make for a contented crew.

options.outcome: The stores come aboard. Tonight the crew of {crew} eats like gentlemen.
The old stores will do. The cook says nothing, pointedly.
